issues.display_title: Issue #528: Refactor Posts Module Edit and Panorama Flows
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Posts Module Edit and Panorama Flows

Summary

Refactored src/Action/V1/Posts/ editing handlers (EditPostPanorama, EditPostDescription, EditHotspotBanner, and UpdatePostVideo) by extracting shared query parameter resolvers (sl, pw, us), category validators, panorama filter and animation parsers, hotspot model construction, and response formatters into post_edit_helpers.go. Hardened Fiber context type assertions and established a unit test suite in post_edit_helpers_test.go.

Files Updated

1. src/Action/V1/Posts/post_edit_helpers.go

  • ResolveEditPostQuerySid(sl, pw string) string: Resolves id = ? vs slug = ? for post edit requests based on sl and pw.
  • ResolveVideoPostQuerySid(sl, us string) string: Resolves id = ? vs slug = ? for video post updates based on sl and us.
  • ParseAndValidatePostCategory(catStr string) (int64, bool): Validates and parses post category ID (range 1-7, defaults to 1).
  • ParseAndValidateVideoCategory(catStr string, defaultCat int64) (int64, bool): Validates and parses video category ID (range 1-3, fallback to default).
  • ParsePanoramaFilter(isFilter bool, filterType string, filterValueStr string) (string, fiber.Map): Safely unmarshals filter JSON with sensible defaults.
  • ParsePanoramaAnimation(animation bool, animationValueStr string) fiber.Map: Safely unmarshals animation JSON with nil fallback.
  • BuildHotspotModel(...) Models.PostHotspots: Safely parses hotspot sequence, type, coordinates, and data into Models.PostHotspots.
  • BuildEditPostDescriptionUpdates(...) map[string]interface{}: Constructs database update map for post description, category, and location.
  • BuildDefaultThumbPostUpdates(...) map[string]interface{}: Constructs database update map for setting default thumbnail post.
  • BuildEditPostDescriptionResponse(slug string) map[string]interface{}: Formats standard response for EditPostDescription.
  • BuildEditHotspotResponse(slug string) map[string]interface{}: Formats standard response for EditHotspotBanner.
  • BuildUpdatePostVideoResponse() map[string]interface{}: Formats standard response for UpdatePostVideo.
  • BuildEditPostPanoramaResponse(sid string) map[string]interface{}: Formats standard response for EditPostPanorama.

2. src/Action/V1/Posts/post_edit_helpers_test.go

  • Added 10 unit test functions covering:
    • TestResolveEditPostQuerySid: Tests combinations of sl and pw.
    • TestResolveVideoPostQuerySid: Tests combinations of sl and us.
    • TestParseAndValidatePostCategory: Tests empty default, valid values (1-7), and out-of-range rejections.
    • TestParseAndValidateVideoCategory: Tests default fallback, valid values (1-3), and out-of-range rejections.
    • TestParsePanoramaFilter: Tests default and custom filter parsing.
    • TestParsePanoramaAnimation: Tests false animation and custom animation parsing.
    • TestBuildHotspotModel: Tests sequence parsing and model construction.
    • TestBuildEditPostDescriptionUpdates: Tests update map dictionary construction.
    • TestBuildDefaultThumbPostUpdates: Tests default thumb update map construction.
    • TestEditPostResponses: Tests payload structures for all 4 handlers.

3. Handlers in src/Action/V1/Posts/

  • EditPostDescription.go:
    • Replaced inline query resolution with ResolveEditPostQuerySid.
    • Replaced category parsing with ParseAndValidatePostCategory.
    • Replaced update map building with BuildEditPostDescriptionUpdates.
    • Replaced response dictionary with BuildEditPostDescriptionResponse.
    • Added safe type assertions on Fiber locals (role, encrypt, userId).
  • EditHotspotBanner.go:
    • Replaced inline hotspot model construction with BuildHotspotModel.
    • Replaced response dictionary with BuildEditHotspotResponse.
    • Added safe type assertions on Fiber locals.
  • UpdatePostVideo.go:
    • Replaced query resolution with ResolveVideoPostQuerySid.
    • Replaced video category parsing with ParseAndValidateVideoCategory.
    • Replaced response dictionary with BuildUpdatePostVideoResponse.
    • Added safe type assertions on Fiber locals.
  • EditPostPanorama.go:
    • Replaced query resolution with ResolveEditPostQuerySid.
    • Replaced filter and animation parsing with ParsePanoramaFilter and ParsePanoramaAnimation.
    • Replaced thumbnail update map construction with BuildDefaultThumbPostUpdates.
    • Replaced response dictionary with BuildEditPostPanoramaResponse.
    • Added safe type assertions on Fiber locals.

Verification

go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Posts/...
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Posts
go test ./...
  • All unit tests in src/Action/V1/Posts passed.
  • go vet reported zero issues.
  • Entire project test suite across all packages passed cleanly.

Problem

The post and panorama editing handlers in src/Action/V1/Posts/ (EditPostPanorama.go, EditPostDescription.go, EditHotspotBanner.go, and UpdatePostVideo.go) contain duplicated logic, repetitive category and query sid resolutions, and unsafe type assertions:

  1. Unsafe Type Assertions: Multiple context assertions (c.Locals("role").(string), c.Locals("encrypt").(string), c.Locals("userId").(string)) without type guards, risking runtime panics.
  2. Duplicated Query Sid Resolvers: Custom branching for sl and pw query/form parameters to resolve id = ? vs slug = ?.
  3. Scattered Category Validations: Post categories (valid range 1-7, default 1) and video categories (valid range 1-3, default from record) were validated manually with inline branching and printing.
  4. Duplicated Filter and Animation Parsing: Parsing of JSON strings for panorama filters (LittlePlanetFilter) and animations (AnimationPost, animation_filter) was repeated with manual type assertions across EditPostPanorama.go and UpdatePostVideo.go.
  5. Hotspot Construction: Building Models.PostHotspots and casting sequence numbers (float64, int64, int) was written inline inside transaction blocks.

Scope

  • Create src/Action/V1/Posts/post_edit_helpers.go:
    • ResolveEditPostQuerySid: Resolves query column (id = ? vs slug = ?) for post edit requests based on sl and pw.
    • ResolveVideoPostQuerySid: Resolves query column for video post updates based on sl and us.
    • ParseAndValidatePostCategory: Validates and parses post category ID (1-7, defaults to 1).
    • ParseAndValidateVideoCategory: Validates and parses video category ID (1-3, fallback to default).
    • ParsePanoramaFilter: Helper to resolve filter type and filter value map with defaults.
    • ParsePanoramaAnimation: Helper to resolve animation value map.
    • BuildHotspotModel: Constructs Models.PostHotspots with safe sequence parsing.
    • BuildDefaultThumbPostUpdates: Prepares database update map for setting default thumbnail post.
    • BuildEditPostDescriptionUpdates: Prepares database update map for post description, location, and visibility.
    • BuildEditPostDescriptionResponse: Standardized response map for EditPostDescription.
    • BuildEditHotspotResponse: Standardized response map for EditHotspotBanner.
    • BuildUpdatePostVideoResponse: Standardized response map for UpdatePostVideo.
    • BuildEditPostPanoramaResponse: Standardized response map for EditPostPanorama.
  • Refactor EditPostPanorama.go, EditPostDescription.go, EditHotspotBanner.go, and UpdatePostVideo.go to use post_edit_helpers.go.
  • Add comprehensive unit tests in src/Action/V1/Posts/post_edit_helpers_test.go.

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% backward compatible: No changes to endpoint contracts, request payloads, response payloads, status codes, or database models.

Acceptance Criteria

  • post_edit_helpers.go implemented and used across all 4 edit handlers.
  • post_edit_helpers_test.go implemented with comprehensive unit tests.
  • All tests in src/Action/V1/Posts/... pass (go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Posts).
  • go vet ./src/Action/V1/Posts reports zero issues.
  • Entire project test suite passes cleanly (go test ./...).

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-10-02.

issues.display_title: Issue #529: Refactor Posts Module Upload and Storage Flows
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Posts Module Upload and Storage Flows

Summary

Refactored src/Action/V1/Posts/ upload and storage handlers (UploadPanoramaPost, UploadPanoramaGDrive, UploadPanoramaDbx, UploadAttachments, CreateFolderGD, and DownloadUploadFileGDV1) by extracting query resolvers, quota validations, dimension formatting, file size calculations, extension checks, Best 360 type resolution, and response builders into post_upload_helpers.go. Replaced critical server-crashing log.Fatalln calls in MinIO flows with graceful error handling and local file cleanups. Hardened Fiber context type assertions and established unit tests in post_upload_helpers_test.go.

Files Updated

1. src/Action/V1/Posts/post_upload_helpers.go

  • ResolveMultiplePostQuerySid(sl string) string: Resolves post_id = ? vs slug = ? for multiple post queries based on sl.
  • ValidateMultiplePostQuota(total int64, maxAllowed int64) bool: Validates multiple post count against allowed maximum limit (defaults to 10).
  • FormatDimension(width, height int) string: Returns standardized %dx%d dimension string.
  • CalculateFileSizeMB(sizeBytes int64) int8: Computes rounded file size in MB.
  • IsValidPanoramaExtension(ext string) bool: Validates file extension against supported types (jpg, jpeg, png).
  • NormalizeAttachmentAction(action string) (string, bool): Maps attachment action strings (contact us -> c, report bug -> b).
  • ResolveBest360PostType(fileCount int) (string, int, string): Determines whether Google Drive Best 360 post is panorama or multiple, and bounds check 0..10 files.
  • BuildMultiplePostRecord(...) map[string]interface{}: Formats insert record map for Models.MultiplePost including optional dropbox URL.
  • BuildPanoramaUploadResponse(...) map[string]interface{}: Formats standardized response for panorama uploads with optional version field.
  • BuildAttachmentFilename(dateStr, randomHex, ext string) string: Creates structured attachment file name.
  • BuildAttachmentResponse(...) map[string]interface{}: Formats standardized response for attachment uploads.

2. src/Action/V1/Posts/post_upload_helpers_test.go

  • Added 11 unit test functions:
    • TestResolveMultiplePostQuerySid: Tests sl flag resolution.
    • TestValidateMultiplePostQuota: Tests threshold boundaries and defaults.
    • TestFormatDimension: Tests dimension string formatting.
    • TestCalculateFileSizeMB: Tests MB calculations.
    • TestIsValidPanoramaExtension: Tests valid and invalid file extensions.
    • TestNormalizeAttachmentAction: Tests mapping for contact us and report bug actions.
    • TestResolveBest360PostType: Tests 0, 1, 5, and 11 file counts.
    • TestBuildMultiplePostRecord: Tests database map construction with and without Dropbox URL.
    • TestBuildPanoramaUploadResponse: Tests response structure with and without version.
    • TestBuildAttachmentFilename: Tests filename composition.
    • TestBuildAttachmentResponse: Tests attachment payload formatting.

3. Handlers in src/Action/V1/Posts/

  • UploadPanoramaPost.go:
    • Replaced unsafe c.Locals assertions with safe type guards.
    • Replaced query resolution with ResolveMultiplePostQuerySid.
    • Replaced quota validation with ValidateMultiplePostQuota.
    • Replaced log.Fatalln in MinIO initialization and upload with graceful 500 error responses and os.Remove(imgPanorama).
    • Used CalculateFileSizeMB, FormatDimension, BuildMultiplePostRecord, and BuildPanoramaUploadResponse.
  • UploadPanoramaGDrive.go:
    • Replaced unsafe c.Locals assertions with safe type guards.
    • Replaced query resolution with ResolveMultiplePostQuerySid.
    • Replaced quota check with ValidateMultiplePostQuota.
    • Replaced log.Fatalln with graceful 500 errors and temporary file cleanup.
    • Used FormatDimension, BuildMultiplePostRecord, and BuildPanoramaUploadResponse.
  • UploadPanoramaDbx.go:
    • Replaced unsafe c.Locals assertions with safe type guards.
    • Replaced query resolution with ResolveMultiplePostQuerySid.
    • Replaced quota check with ValidateMultiplePostQuota.
    • Replaced log.Fatalln with graceful 500 errors and temporary file cleanup.
    • Used FormatDimension, BuildMultiplePostRecord, and BuildPanoramaUploadResponse.
  • UploadAttachments.go:
    • Used NormalizeAttachmentAction for action parsing and validation.
    • Used BuildAttachmentFilename and BuildAttachmentResponse.
    • Removed unused fmt import.
  • CreateFolderGD.go:
    • Replaced unsafe c.Locals assertions (encrypt, userId) with safe type guards.
  • DownloadUploadFileGDV1.go:
    • Replaced unsafe c.Locals assertions with safe type guards.
    • Replaced file count branching with ResolveBest360PostType.
    • Replaced file extension checking with IsValidPanoramaExtension.

Verification

go test -v -count=1 ./src/Action/V1/Posts
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Posts
go build ./...
  • All unit tests in src/Action/V1/Posts passed cleanly.
  • go vet reported zero issues.
  • go build ./... compiled with zero errors across all packages.

Problem

The post panorama upload and storage handlers in src/Action/V1/Posts/ (UploadPanoramaPost.go, UploadPanoramaGDrive.go, UploadPanoramaDbx.go, UploadAttachments.go, CreateFolderGD.go, and DownloadUploadFileGDV1.go) contain duplicated logic, runtime crash risks, and unsafe type assertions:

  1. Critical log.Fatalln Crash Risks: In UploadPanoramaPost.go, UploadPanoramaGDrive.go, and UploadPanoramaDbx.go, failure to initialize MinIO or upload a file triggers log.Fatalln, which kills the entire HTTP server process instead of returning a 500 error and cleaning up temporary files.
  2. Unsafe Type Assertions: Direct assertions on Fiber locals (c.Locals("userId").(string), c.Locals("encrypt").(string), c.Locals("role").(string)) without type guards, risking runtime panics.
  3. Duplicated Multiple Post Quota & Existence Queries: UploadPanoramaPost.go, UploadPanoramaGDrive.go, and UploadPanoramaDbx.go each query views_total_multiple_posts with redundant sl query resolution (slug = ? vs post_id = ?) and manual quota validation (total_multiple_post >= 10).
  4. Scattered Image / Attachment Metadata Calculations: Image dimensions (%dx%d), file sizes in MB, MIME type validations, and extension checks are repeated across multiple handlers.
  5. Duplicated Response Formats: Panorama upload responses and attachment upload responses share common payload keys (valid, messages, u_name, thumbnail) constructed inline.
  6. Best 360 File Count & Type Resolution: File count validations (0, 1, or > 10 files) and postType selection (panorama vs multiple) are coded inline in DownloadUploadFileGDV1.go.

Scope

  • Create src/Action/V1/Posts/post_upload_helpers.go:
    • ResolveMultiplePostQuerySid: Resolves query column (post_id = ? vs slug = ?) for multiple post lookup based on sl.
    • ValidateMultiplePostQuota: Validates whether the current total multiple posts count has reached the maximum allowed limit (10).
    • FormatDimension: Standardizes string dimension format (%dx%d).
    • CalculateFileSizeMB: Computes rounded file size in MB (int8).
    • IsValidPanoramaExtension: Checks if a file extension is supported (jpg, jpeg, png).
    • NormalizeAttachmentAction: Validates and maps attachment action (contact us -> c, report bug -> b).
    • ResolveBest360PostType: Validates Google Drive folder file count and resolves post type (panorama vs multiple).
    • BuildMultiplePostRecord: Constructs database record map for Models.MultiplePost.
    • BuildPanoramaUploadResponse: Formats standardized response for panorama uploads.
    • BuildAttachmentResponse: Formats standardized response for attachment uploads.
  • Refactor handlers:
    • UploadPanoramaPost.go: Replace log.Fatalln with graceful error handling, safe locals, and helper methods.
    • UploadPanoramaGDrive.go: Replace log.Fatalln, safe locals, and helper methods.
    • UploadPanoramaDbx.go: Replace log.Fatalln, safe locals, and helper methods.
    • UploadAttachments.go: Use action and response helpers.
    • CreateFolderGD.go: Safe locals and clean error handling.
    • DownloadUploadFileGDV1.go: Safe locals, Best 360 type resolution helper, and extension check helper.
  • Establish comprehensive unit test suite in src/Action/V1/Posts/post_upload_helpers_test.go.

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% backward compatible: No changes to endpoint URLs, query parameters, request bodies, response JSON keys, HTTP status codes, or database schemas.
  • Prevent server crashes: Gracefully return 500 error instead of log.Fatalln when MinIO operations fail, and clean up temporary files on disk.

Acceptance Criteria

  • post_upload_helpers.go implemented and used across the 6 upload/storage handlers.
  • post_upload_helpers_test.go implemented covering all helper functions.
  • All tests in src/Action/V1/Posts pass cleanly (go test -v -count=1 ./src/Action/V1/Posts).
  • go vet ./src/Action/V1/Posts reports zero issues.
  • go build ./... compiles cleanly without errors.
  • Document implementation in docs/tasks/implementations/2026-10-02/refactor_posts_upload_and_storage_impl.md.

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-10-02.

issues.display_title: Issue #530: Trail Post: Migration for post_trails, post_trail_points and Trail Category
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: BE-02 Database Migration for post_trails, post_trail_points & Trail Category

Summary

Created database schema migrations and GORM models for the Trail Post feature in CockroachDB dialect, following established patterns from post_hotspots and category seeds, fulfilling Epic #578 and Issue #530.

Files Created & Updated

  1. migrations/20261002_trail_post.sql:
    • Table public.post_trails (1:1 with posts, PK post_id, FK cascade on delete).
    • Table public.post_trail_points (1:n with posts, PK id, unique on (post_id, sequence), FK cascade on delete).
    • Seed categories with (8, 'Trail') using ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE.
  2. src/Models/PostTrail.go:
    • GORM model PostTrail mapped to table post_trails.
  3. src/Models/PostTrailPoint.go:
    • GORM model PostTrailPoint mapped to table post_trail_points.

Schema Specification

1. Table: post_trails

Column Type Constraints / Defaults Description
post_id UUID PK, FK posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE 1:1 post reference
activity_type STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT '' Enum: hiking, trail-running, mountain-biking, walking, off-road
difficulty STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT '' Enum: easy, medium, hard, expert
total_distance_km DECIMAL(10,3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 Total route distance
elevation_gain_m DECIMAL(8,1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 Total ascent in meters
elevation_loss_m DECIMAL(8,1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 Total descent in meters
elevation_min_m DECIMAL(8,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 Lowest elevation point
elevation_max_m DECIMAL(8,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 Highest elevation point
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() Record creation timestamp
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() Record update timestamp

2. Table: post_trail_points

Column Type Constraints / Defaults Description
id UUID PK, DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() Point ID
post_id UUID FK posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE Parent post ID
sequence INT8 NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 1..n route order (UNIQUE with post_id)
url STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT '' Embed tour URL
tour_key STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT '' Extracted tour key (without F1/G1 prefix)
name STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT '' Waypoint name (max 100 chars)
height_m DECIMAL(8,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 User input elevation (0 is valid)
latitude FLOAT8 NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 APIL verified latitude
longitude FLOAT8 NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 APIL verified longitude
thumbnail STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT '' Waypoint thumbnail image URL
distance_km DECIMAL(10,3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 Cumulative distance from start (km)
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() Point creation timestamp
updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() Point update timestamp

3. Category Seed

  • ID: 8, Name: 'Trail'

Epic: GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go#578 (trail-post)
PRD: docs/prd/2026-10-02-trail-post-prd.md in panorra-api-go, task BE-02
Estimate: 0.5 day

Problem

A trail post needs per-post trail attributes and an ordered list of key points. Today an embed post stores a single URL in posts.panorama, and there is no Trail category in categories (the PWA pins id 8).

Scope

  • One migration in migrations/ (CockroachDB dialect, same conventions as 20260810_post_hotspots.sql).
  • post_trails, 1:1 with posts:
    • post_id UUID PK, FK posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    • activity_type STRING, difficulty STRING
    • total_distance_km DECIMAL(10,3)
    • elevation_gain_m DECIMAL(8,1), elevation_loss_m DECIMAL(8,1)
    • elevation_min_m DECIMAL(8,2), elevation_max_m DECIMAL(8,2)
    • created_at, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ
  • post_trail_points, one row per key point:
    • id UUID PK, post_id UUID FK posts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    • sequence INT8 (1..n, route order), unique (post_id, sequence)
    • url STRING, tour_key STRING, name STRING
    • height_m DECIMAL(8,2) DEFAULT 0
    • latitude FLOAT8, longitude FLOAT8, thumbnail STRING
    • distance_km DECIMAL(10,3) (cumulative from the first point)
    • created_at, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ
  • Seed category (8, 'Trail'), same upsert style as 20260828_seed_categories.sql.
  • GORM models for both tables.

Out of scope

  • No new columns on posts. Category, location, visibility and draft state stay there.

Notes

  • The migration runner splits statements on ;, so no semicolon inside a statement.
  • GET /categories in panorra-api-go caches the list in Redis (<prefix>_categories). The key must be refreshed after the seed, and the PWA hides Trail from the normal post category picker.

Acceptance Criteria

  • make migrate target=local applies cleanly on a fresh and on an existing database.
  • Category id 8 is named Trail.
  • Deleting a post removes its post_trails and post_trail_points rows.

issues.display_title: Issue #531: Trail Post: Parse and Validate the trail Field
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: BE-04 Parse and Validate trail Field

Summary

Implemented pure helper functions (with no database or network dependencies) to parse and validate the multipart trail JSON field for both draft and publish actions, fulfilling Epic #578 and Issue #531.

Files Created & Updated

  1. src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/trail_validation.go:
    • Structs: TrailInput, TrailPointInput, ParsedTrailPoint, TrailValidationError.
    • ParseTourURL(rawURL string) (prefix, tourKey string, err error): Extracts F1 or G1 prefix and tour_key from https://tourmkr.com/... URLs.
    • ParseAndValidateTrail(trailJSON string, isPublish bool) (*TrailInput, []ParsedTrailPoint, *TrailValidationError): Enforces business validation rules.
  2. src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/trail_validation_test.go:
    • 28 unit tests covering all draft, publish, URL parsing, and mathematical sanity rules.

Validation Specification

Rule Draft Mode Publish Mode Error Response Input
JSON syntax Valid JSON required Valid JSON required trail
Points count Min 1 point Min 1 point (no upper cap) trail.points
Point URL https://tourmkr.com/F1... or G1... Same trail.points[i].url
URL uniqueness No duplicate URLs across points No duplicate URLs trail.points[i].url
Prefix consistency All F1 or all G1 for entire trail Same trail.points[i].url
Lat & Lng Numbers required Numbers required trail.points[i].url
Point name Optional Required, max 100 characters trail.points[i].name
Height (height_m) Optional (default 0), max 2 decimals Max 2 decimals, 0 is valid trail.points[i].height_m
Difficulty Optional Required: easy, medium, hard, expert trail.difficulty
Activity Type Optional Required: hiking, trail-running, mountain-biking, walking, off-road trail.activity_type
Distance metrics Optional Required, >= 0 trail.total_distance_km, trail.elevation_gain_m, trail.elevation_loss_m
Elevation range Optional min <= max, must match smallest & largest height_m trail.elevation_min_m, trail.elevation_max_m
Point cumulative distance Optional First point 0, monotonically non-decreasing, last equals total_distance_km trail.points[i].distance_km

Epic: GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go#578 (trail-post)
PRD: docs/prd/2026-10-02-trail-post-prd.md in panorra-api-go, task BE-04
Estimate: 1 day

Problem

POST /posts/complete-embed will receive a new multipart field, trail, holding a JSON string. It needs a parser and validation rules that differ between draft and publish, kept out of the handler so they can be unit-tested.

Scope

Pure helpers (no DB, no HTTP) that parse and validate trail:

Field Draft Publish Rule
difficulty optional required easy, medium, hard, expert
activity_type optional required hiking, trail-running, mountain-biking, walking, off-road
total_distance_km optional required number, not negative
elevation_gain_m, elevation_loss_m optional required number, not negative
elevation_min_m, elevation_max_m optional required min <= max, and equal to the smallest and largest height_m in points
points min 1 min 1, no upper limit array order is the route order
points[].url required required https://tourmkr.com/F1… or G1…; no duplicates; one prefix for the whole post
points[].name optional required max 100 characters
points[].height_m default 0 default 0 number, max 2 decimals; 0 is valid
points[].lat, points[].lng required required numbers
points[].distance_km optional required first point 0, never decreasing, last point equals total_distance_km
points[].thumbnail optional optional URL
  • Parse the prefix (F1 / G1) and tour_key out of each URL (the cron in CheckEmbedTourmkr.go already does basename[:2] / basename[2:]).
  • Errors use Functions.ErrorResponse with a 400 and one errors.input per failure: trail, trail.points, trail.points[i].url, trail.points[i].name, trail.points[i].height_m, trail.difficulty, trail.activity_type, trail.total_distance_km (and the other metric names).

Out of scope

  • Route metrics are computed by the PWA. The backend only checks that they are sane; it does not recompute distance or elevation.
  • No estimated duration.
  • Ownership and publish status of a tour (BE-06).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Unit tests (stdlib testing) cover: valid draft, valid publish, each rule in the table failing, mixed F1/G1, duplicate URL, broken JSON.
  • height_m: 0 passes on publish.

issues.display_title: Issue #532: Trail Post: Save Trail and Points in /posts/complete-embed
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: BE-05 Save Trail in /posts/complete-embed

Summary

Integrated the trail post type into the core embed creation pipeline (POST /posts/complete-embed), saving trail metadata and ordered waypoints atomically in a single transaction, fulfilling Epic #578 and Issue #532.

Files Created & Updated

  1. src/Action/V1/Posts/AddPostCompleteEmbed.go:
    • Added case "trail": postType = "trail" to isPost switch.
    • For isPost == "trail", sets categoryId = 8 automatically and assigns urlEmbed from the first waypoint URL.
    • Enforces location requirement on publish (location_name is the post title).
    • Wrapped posts, post_trails, and post_trail_points in a single database transaction.
  2. src/Action/V1/Posts/DeleteDraftPost.go:
    • Added "trail" to embed post types so deleting a trail draft deletes files and database rows cascade cleanly.
  3. src/Utils/Redis/post_cache.go:
    • Added case "trail": qPost.Where("post_type = ?", "trail") in ReplaceEmbedPost.

Frontend Integration Guide

Endpoint

POST /posts/complete-embed

Headers

Header Value Description
Authorization Bearer <JWT_TOKEN> Required
Content-Type multipart/form-data Required

Form Fields (Multipart)

Field Type Required Description
sid string Yes Upload session ID from /posts/init
is_post string Yes Must be "trail"
action string No "draft" (default) or "publish"
description string Yes Post description (1 - 2200 characters)
visibility string No "public" (default), "unlisted", or "private"
location string On Publish JSON string containing place details. location_name is used as the title.
little_planet string Yes Send "false"
animation string Yes Send "false"
trail string Yes Stringified JSON of the trail structure

Example Usage

1. Save Trail Draft

curl -X POST "https://api-post.panorra.com/posts/complete-embed" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>" \
  -F "sid=c943fb9a747-2026100209214600" \
  -F "is_post=trail" \
  -F "action=draft" \
  -F "description=Drafting Mount Pancar scenic hiking route" \
  -F "little_planet=false" \
  -F "animation=false" \
  -F 'trail={
    "points": [
      {

Epic: GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go#578 (trail-post)
PRD: docs/prd/2026-10-02-trail-post-prd.md in panorra-api-go, task BE-05
Estimate: 1.5 days

Problem

Trail posts are saved through the existing embed flow. POST /posts/complete-embed must accept a new post type and store the trail and its points; other embed types must not change.

Scope

  • Accept is_post=trail, stored as post_type = 'trail' (new case in the type switch at AddPostCompleteEmbed.go).
  • For is_post=trail:
    • trail (JSON string) is required and validated with the BE-04 helpers.
    • category_id is no longer required; the backend sets it to 8 (Trail).
    • url is the first point's URL; posts.panorama and panorama_preview keep that URL so feeds and thumbnails keep working.
    • location is required on publish. location_name is what the PWA shows as the post title.
  • In one transaction: update posts, upsert post_trails, delete then re-insert post_trail_points.
  • Publish keeps the existing steps (counters, embed cache, location grouping).
  • Add trail wherever embed types are hardcoded: the type map in DeleteDraftPost.go (treated as embed) and Redis.ReplaceEmbedPost.
  • Response is unchanged: {statusCode: 200, data: {valid, messages, slug, thumbnail}}, including the ec encrypted form.

Out of scope

  • Tour ownership and publish check (BE-06). Until that lands, lat/lng come from the request.
  • Editing after publish (BE-13).

Depends on

BE-02 (tables), BE-04 (validation).

Acceptance Criteria

  • is_post=tourmkr, gvt, villume and video behave exactly as before.
  • A trail draft can be saved, saved again with different points, then published.
  • DELETE /posts/delete-draft/:sid?type=trail removes the draft and its trail rows.
  • A failed save leaves no partial post_trails / post_trail_points rows.

issues.display_title: Issue #533: Trail Post: Verify Tour Ownership and Publish Status via APIL
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: BE-06 Verify Tour Ownership & Publish Status via APIL

Summary

Integrated Keycloak service token authentication and GoThru APIL provider client into panorra-api-new, validating that all tours in a trail are strictly owned by the caller and in a published state (foverlay_active for F1 or goverlay_active for G1 with values 1 or 3), fulfilling Epic #578 and Issue #533.

Files Created & Updated

  1. src/Config/Connection.go:
    • Added configuration variables for Keycloak and GoThru API base URL.
  2. src/Models/GoThruIntegration.go:
    • Added DTO models for provider communication.
  3. src/Utils/Keycloak/Keycloak.go:
    • Thread-safe service account token acquisition with in-memory caching.
  4. src/Utils/GoThru/GoThru.go:
    • HTTP client calling GoThru APIL GET /internal/users/{uuid}/virtual-tours with UTF-8 BOM stripping.
  5. src/Action/V1/Posts/TourVerification.go:
    • Implemented VerifyTrailTours with bounded concurrency worker pool (up to 5 parallel workers).
    • Resolves keycloak_sub from user_keycloak_link.
    • Validates tour existence and overlay status.
    • Overwrites point lat and lng with provider coordinates.
  6. src/Action/V1/Posts/TourVerification_test.go:
    • 6 unit tests covering ownership, overlays, errors, and coordinates.

Error Handling Specifications

1. User Not Linked to GoThru

  • HTTP Status: 400 Bad Request
{
  "statusCode": 400,
  "data": {
    "status": "Bad Request",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "User is not linked to GoThru account",
      "input": "trail"
    }
  }
}

2. Tour Not Owned by User

  • HTTP Status: 400 Bad Request
{
  "statusCode": 400,
  "data": {
    "status": "Bad Request",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Tour not found or not owned by user",
      "input": "trail.points[0].url"
    }
  }
}

3. Tour Unpublished (Overlay Not Active)

  • HTTP Status: 400 Bad Request
{
  "statusCode": 400,
  "data": {
    "status": "Bad Request",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Tour is not published",
      "input": "trail.points[1].url"
    }
  }
}

4. APIL Down

  • HTTP Status: 502 Bad Gateway
{
  "statusCode": 502,
  "data": {
    "status": "Bad Gateway",
    "valid": false,
    "errors": {
      "message": "Failed to contact GoThru provider",
      "input": "trail.points[0].url"
    }
  }
}

Epic: GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go#578 (trail-post)
PRD: docs/prd/2026-10-02-trail-post-prd.md in panorra-api-go, task BE-06
Estimate: 2 days

Problem

A trail may only contain tours that are published on GoThru and owned by the user saving the post (PM, 2 Oct 2026). Nothing checks this today: the embed URL is stored as sent. panorra-api-new also has no GoThru client or Keycloak service token; both exist only in panorra-api-go.

Scope

  • Bring the GoThru client and the Keycloak service-token helper over from panorra-api-go (src/Utils/GoThru, src/Utils/Keycloak). Config keys already used there: GOTHRU_API_BASE_URL (fallback API_GOTHRU), KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL, KEYCLOAK_REALM, KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID, KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET.
  • Resolve the user's keycloak_sub from user_keycloak_link.
  • For each point, call APIL: GET {GOTHRU_API_BASE_URL}/internal/users/{keycloak_sub}/virtual-tours?search={tour_key}, then match tour_key exactly. That list only holds the user's own tours, so a missing match means "not yours".
  • Reject the save when a tour is missing, or its overlay is not active: foverlay_active for an F1 URL, goverlay_active for a G1 URL; values 1 and 3 count as active (same rule as APIL's /panorra/check-active-tour).
  • Overwrite lat/lng of each point with the values from APIL. Thumbnail stays as sent by the PWA until APIL returns one.
  • One call per point: run them in parallel with a timeout and a bounded number of workers.
  • Strip a leading UTF-8 BOM before decoding APIL JSON. Successful responses of two public APIL endpoints start with EF BB BF; whether the internal endpoint does the same could not be checked without a service token.
  • Errors: 400 with errors.input = trail.points[i].url; a user with no Keycloak link gets a clear 400; APIL failure maps to 502.

Out of scope

  • No APIW (apiw.gothru.co) calls.
  • No changes in GoThru-API-New. A tour_keys filter there would turn this into a single call, but is not required.

Depends on

BE-05.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Saving with another user's tour key fails with trail.points[i].url.
  • Saving with an unpublished tour fails the same way.
  • Saved points carry APIL's lat/lng.
  • Tests use a stubbed APIL (httptest), including a response that starts with a BOM.

issues.display_title: Issue #534: Trail Post: Edit Trail After Publish (POST /posts/edit-trail)
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: BE-13 Edit Trail After Publish (POST /posts/edit-trail)

Summary

Implemented POST /posts/edit-trail to allow editing published trail posts (reordering, adding, or deleting waypoints and updating route metrics) in a single atomic transaction, while ensuring POST /posts/edit-description maintains category_id = 8 for trail posts, fulfilling Epic #578 and Issue #534.

Files Created & Updated

  1. src/Action/V1/Posts/EditTrail.go:
    • Implemented EditTrail(c *fiber.Ctx) handler.
    • Enforces post ownership, published status (is_publish = true), and post_type = 'trail'. Non-matching posts return HTTP 409 "Post Not Found".
    • Executes publish validation rules and APIL tour verification.
    • Executes atomic transaction: updates post_trails, deletes old post_trail_points, inserts new points, updates posts.panorama and panorama_preview to the first point URL.
  2. src/Action/V1/Posts/EditPostDescription.go:
    • Modified to inspect post_type upon lookup: for trail posts (post_type == 'trail'), forces category_id = 8 without rejecting requests or altering the Trail category.
  3. src/Controllers/V1/PostsController.go & src/Routes/V1/PostsRoutes.go:
    • Registered POST /posts/edit-trail.
  4. src/Action/V1/Posts/EditTrail_test.go:
    • Unit tests covering missing parameters, validation, and error states.

Frontend Integration Guide

Endpoint

Headers

Header Value Description

Content-Type multipart/form-data Required

Form Fields (Multipart)

Field Type Required Description

trail string Yes JSON string of the updated trail structure

        "lat": -6.5806,
        "lng": 106.9005,
        "distance_km": 0,
        "thumbnail": "https://img.panorra.com/tours/thumb1.jpg"
      },
      {
        "url": "https://tourmkr.com/F1d4e5f6",
        "name": "Taman Wisata Alam Gunung Pancar",
        "height_m": 1200,
        "lat": -6.5771,
        "lng": 106.9052,
        "distance_km": 5.8,

Epic: GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go#578 (trail-post)
PRD: docs/prd/2026-10-02-trail-post-prd.md in panorra-api-go, task BE-13
Estimate: 1 day

Problem

A published trail can be edited, including its points (PM, 2 Oct 2026). There is no endpoint that changes the content of a published embed post; /posts/complete-embed only matches drafts.

Scope

  • POST /posts/edit-trail with sid and trail (same JSON as create).
  • Only for a published post with post_type = 'trail' owned by the caller; otherwise 409 "Post Not Found".
  • Publish validation rules (BE-04) and the tour check (BE-06) apply.
  • In one transaction: update post_trails, delete then re-insert post_trail_points, set posts.panorama / panorama_preview to the first point's URL.
  • /posts/edit-description must keep working for trail posts and must not change their category: today it rejects any category_id above 7.

Out of scope

  • Description, location and visibility keep using /posts/edit-description.
  • No un-publish.

Depends on

BE-05, BE-06.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Points can be reordered, added and removed on a published trail.
  • Editing another user's post, or a non-trail post, returns 409.
  • After /posts/edit-description on a trail post, category_id is still 8.
